create_bulk_from_atoms: create a Bulk object by passing an ase.Atoms object directly
create_bulk_from_db_index: create a Bulk object by selecting from the bulk database using an integer index
create_bulk_from_src_id: create a Bulk object by looking up a source id like mp-30 in the bulk database
create_bulk_random: create a Bulk object by randomly sampling from the bulk database
get_slabs_from_bulk: get all possible slabs for a Bulk instance with an optional max Miller index
